texts: The harbor wall holds twenty-four lanterns.
The fishing boats use the harbor lanterns as beacons at night.
The harbor lanterns are short and squat.
Whenever wind reflects off the water at the harbor wall, a harbor lantern burns its mire-essence quickly.
Harbor-lantern Keepers live near the harbor.

fields.sentence: The harbor wall holds twenty-four lanterns.

review.notes: Stative-transitive 'holds' correctly keeps Agent on the wall and Theme on the counted group (the 'tank holds forty litres' case), the noun modifier of harbor_wall is rightly left unexposed, and the bare present takes no status atom. 'harbor wall' sits near the fuse-vs-part-whole line ('car engine'), but the classifier reading is defensible.

fields.sentence: The fishing boats use the harbor lanterns as beacons at night.
parse: (: l16_boats_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_boats_1) (And (Member (sk_use $x) use) (Agent (sk_use $x) $x) (Theme (sk_use $x) sk_lanterns_1) (As (sk_use $x) beacon) (Time (sk_use $x) night))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: predicative 'as NP' complement of a verb ('use X as beacons') — a role/capacity secondary predicate; the instruction set covers resultative and depictive secondary predicates but not the 'V NP as NP' capacity phrase, so the parse falls back on the preposition-named oblique (As), which the oblique rule frames only for PPs answering where/when/how or naming what the activity is about
review.notes: Group event plus the per-member PartOf rule for a definite plural with a distributive predicate is the mandated pair; 'use' correctly takes Theme, 'at night' the bare day-part Time symbol, and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom.

fields.sentence: The harbor lanterns are short and squat.

review.notes: Definite plural takes a group witness with the two coordinated copular predicates distributed as separate per-member rules, as the plural doctrine requires. The fused classifier compound rides the GroupOf kind slot with its genus emitted and its noun modifier left unexposed.

fields.sentence: Whenever wind reflects off the water at the harbor wall, a harbor lantern burns its mire-essence quickly.
parse: (: whenever_reflect_burn (Implication (And (Member $e reflect) (Patient $e wind) (Off $e sk_water_1)) (And (Member (sk_burn $e) burn) (Agent (sk_burn $e) sk_lantern_1) (Patient (sk_burn $e) sk_essence_1) (Manner (sk_burn $e) quickly) (During (sk_burn $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's indefinite "a harbor lantern" is bound to the single top-level constant sk_lantern_1 (and its essence to sk_essence_1) instead of a Skolem function of the trigger variable, so every occurrence fires on the same one lantern rather than some lantern per occurrence, contrary to the dependent-existential machinery.

Hoisting that indefinite's witness and typing to top level (with statements 6 and 8) asserts unconditionally that a particular harbor lantern and its mire-essence exist, which the conditional sentence never asserts.

review.notes: Rule shape, the During link, the 1.0/0.9 TV, the absent QuantifierPhrase, and the harbor_wall / harbor_lantern / mire_essence genus atoms all follow the whenever machinery and Compound concepts. (Off $e sk_water_1) is within the prepositional-verb oblique licence for "reflects off".

issues.reason: The consequent's indefinite 'a harbor lantern' is a dependent existential under the whenever-occurrence universal, so *Quantifiers, generics & scope* requires a Skolem function of the trigger variable (as (sk_book $x) in 'every student read some book'; 'genuine ambiguity -> first quantifier takes wide scope' points the same way), whereas the constant sk_lantern_1 asserts that one particular lantern burns on every occasion — more than the text states.

An indefinite posited only inside a scope-bearing container never projects — the same rule that keeps 'a cooper' inside the strength-0 bundle, an Or-branch's witness inside its branch, and a seal's indefinite sealed — so top-level (Member sk_lantern_1 harbor_lantern), (Member sk_essence_1 mire_essence) and (Possession sk_essence_1 sk_lantern_1) assert unconditionally an existence the conditional only posits per occurrence.

adjudication.defect_summary: For both issues one compliant form fixes them together: keep the indefinite and its possessum inside the consequent as Skolem functions of the trigger — (Member (sk_lantern $e) harbor_lantern), (Agent (sk_burn $e) (sk_lantern $e)), (Member (sk_essence $e) mire_essence), (Patient (sk_burn $e) (sk_essence $e)), (Possession (sk_essence $e) (sk_lantern $e)) — leaving at top level only the definite 'the water' / 'the harbor wall' witnesses and the definitional genus atoms (harbor_wall, harbor_lantern, mire_essence), which are kind-level and assert no existence.
adjudication.notes: Everything else is licensed: the whenever rule shape with its During link and STV 1.0 0.9, the absent QuantifierPhrase, the (Off $e sk_water_1) prepositional oblique, the mechanical 'at' -> LocatedIn read, Patient for the natural-force subject 'wind', and all three compound genus atoms.

fields.sentence: Harbor-lantern Keepers live near the harbor.

q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kind harbor_lantern_keeper gets no head genus (Inheritance harbor_lantern_keeper keeper), which Compound concepts says is always emitted either way, so nothing links the kind to keeper — while the sub-compound harbor_lantern does get its genus.

q2_gaps: Sentence-initial, hyphenated, capitalized plural label ('Harbor-lantern Keepers'): Names and casing makes the cue 'the casing itself, mechanically', but sentence-initial capitalization is indistinguishable from name-hood, the capitalized-plural Name-only rule is stated only for a definite label ('the Wrens'), and nothing says how a hyphenated Capitalized-lowercase run ('Harbor-lantern') delimits the capitalized run.
review.notes: The bare-plural generic rule at 0.9/0.9, the definite 'the harbor' witness with its type atom, and the surface-preposition oblique Near are all as specified, and Agent for 'live' follows the prompt's own Oslo example. Whether the subject is a common compound kind (as parsed, with its capability and kind-relation atoms) or a Name-only individual rests entirely on the unresolved casing question above.

issues.reason: An object-incorporating agent-nominalization fused from the surface is routed by the agent-nominalization bullet, whose worked example emits exactly the capability plus kind-relation the parse gives ((Inheritance egg_layer (can lay)), (Lay egg_layer egg)) and no head genus, and Core patterns defers to that section verbatim ('always emitted, exactly as Compound decomposition specifies'), so the Compound-kind clause's 'always emitted either way' — whose 'either way' governs the MODIFIER-genus branch — is not a rule this parse violates.

gaps_confirmed: Sentence-initial hyphenated capitalized plural label ('Harbor-lantern Keepers'): the Name-only capitalized-plural rule is stated only for a definite label ('the Wrens'), sentence-initial capitalization is uninformative about name-hood, and nothing says how a Capitalized-hyphen-lowercase run delimits the capitalized run.
new_gaps: Two Compound-concepts bullets both match a fused modifier+agent-nominalization symbol (harbor_lantern_keeper, egg_layer, dam_builder) and prescribe different atom sets: Compound kind says the head genus (Inheritance <compound> <head-noun>) is always emitted, while the agent-nominalization bullet's worked example emits only the capability and kind-relation. Which governs is unstated, so two faithful parses can differ by one atom.
adjudication.notes: Every emitted atom is true of the sentence and well-typed: the bare-plural verbal generic becomes a rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion (no quantifier word present), Agent for 'live' matches the prompt's own Oslo example, Near is the preposition actually used rather than a coined synonym head, and the definite 'the harbor' gets its witness plus type atom.
